title: Content reads retry flaky connections
summary: On the web, game content reads now retry transient failures (network errors, 5xx, cut-off bodies) after 400 ms, then 1500 ms. A 4xx is final. Before, one dropped read on a flaky phone connection failed the whole race load, because CPU rosters load one after another. PR #537, issue #520.
details: Verification: atv-content unit tests including the retry policy. A new browser test, test_engine_content_retry.mjs, loaded a race after 12 content files each failed once (503, aborted, cut-off body), and a 404 still failed after 2 requests.
limitation: Tested on a Mac only, not a phone. A permanently refused read (offline) now reports its error about 1.9 s later. One preloaded end-of-race file is not reread during the load.
caption: ENV01 race loaded after 12 content files each failed once (503, aborted, cut-off body); the ride starts with a CPU sled ahead.
